versions.changelog:
- Initial release of frontend-skill.
- Focuses on advanced front-end engineering using the latest AI-era tech stack: React, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript, and Next.js.
- Emphasizes high-quality product experience, strong UI/UX standards, and rapid code development with Glue Code style.
- Strict on component reuse: logic reused twice is componentized; avoids reinventing the wheel.
- Prioritizes security against injection attacks and ensures responsive, adaptable page layouts.
- Defaults to mainstream modern stack if no tech preference specified.
